items.title: Trio Sonata in A major, Op. 1 No. 7

items.title: Upon Silence (version for mezzo-soprano and seven strings)

items.title: Fantasia a 4, VdGS 1

items.title: Fantasia a 4, VdGS 2

items.title: Ground a 5 ("The Queen's Goodnight")

items.title: String Quartet No. 3 ("Devotions")
items.notes: Eight untitled movements; commissioned by the Solem Quartet, inspired by the slow movement of Beethoven's Op. 132

items.title: Quartet in A major, Op. 19 No. 3

items.title: String Quartet No. 4 ("Lucid Dreams")

items.title: A Padmore Cycle (version for tenor and piano trio)
